title: Regularity of solutions to Monge--Ampère equations on compact Hermitian manifolds
summary: We study the stability and Hölder continuity of solutions to degenerate complex Monge--Ampère equations associated with a non-closed big form on compact Hermitian manifolds. We also show that the solution is globally continuous when the reference form is the pullback of a Hermitian metric. As a consequence, we establish a uniform diameter bound for the twisted Chern--Ricci flow.
